claims.statement: For the repository full-line kernel K(t)=Phi(|t|)/2, the Dimitrov-Xu order-two correlation satisfies nu_2(2u)=4 C(u), where C(u)=integral r^2 K(u+r)K(u-r) dr, and the tilted kernel satisfies Psi_y(2u)=4 cosh(2yu) C(u).
Using the Dimitrov-Xu theorem and Wiener's L1 Tauberian theorem, RH is equivalent to strict positivity of the Fourier transform of D_y(u)=cosh(2yu)C(u) for every real frequency and every 0<|y|<1/2.

If H_y(q)=D_y(sqrt(q)) is completely monotone on q>=0 for every 0<|y|<1/2, then D_y is a positive Gaussian mixture with strictly positive Fourier transform, hence RH follows. Complete monotonicity in all orders is not proved.
The internal-tilt kernel J_y(u)=integral r^2 cosh(2yr)K(u+r)K(u-r)dr satisfies 4 Fourier[J_y](2x)=|f'(x+iy)|^2-Re(f''(x+iy) conjugate(f(x+iy))) for f(z)=integral K(t)exp(-izt)dt.
The external Dimitrov-Xu tilt D_y and the internal Jensen tilt J_y are distinct for general y!=0 and coincide only at y=0.

The SOH-G004 channel curvature and variance bounds imply strong convexity of L=-log K. The later SOH-G024-M sharpening raises the global margin to L''>17, hence -C'/C>34u and -H_y'/H_y>33/2 for every q>=0 and 0<|y|<1/2. Therefore H_y'(q)<0 globally.

Integrating the original conservative SOH-G024-F logarithmic-slope bound gives H_y(q)<H_y(0)exp(-19q/2); the sharpened L''>17 result supplies the stronger derivative floor 33/2 without weakening this already-proved Gaussian envelope.

For f(z)=Fourier[K](z), Fourier[nu_2](z)=2(f'(z)^2-f(z)f''(z)), and the external tilted family satisfies 4 Fourier[D_y](2x)=Re(f'(x+iy)^2-f(x+iy)f''(x+iy)). This is distinct from the internal J_y conjugate-modulus identity.

With S_y(q)=-d/dq log H_y(q), one has H_y''/H_y=S_y^2-S_y'. Therefore the second complete-monotonicity inequality is exactly equivalent to S_y'<=S_y^2. SOH-G024-Q and SOH-G024-R close this inequality globally by a computer-assisted fourth-log-curvature certificate plus exact Riccati bounds.

Under the normalized bridge measure dmu_u proportional to r^2 K(u+r)K(u-r)dr/C(u), with A=L'(u+r)+L'(u-r), B=L''(u+r)+L''(u-r), R=-C'/C=E[A], and R'=E[B]-Var(A), define a=|y|, T=2a tanh(2au), N=R-T. Then 4u^3 H_y''(u^2)/H_y(u^2)=N+u[N^2+Var(A)-E[B]+4a^2 sech^2(2au)].

For D_u(r)=L'(u+r)-L'(u-r), the normalized bridge measure satisfies E[r^(2n+1) D_u(r)]=(2n+3)E[r^(2n)] for every n>=0. With the sharpened G024-M margin L''>17 this gives E[r^(2n+2)]<(2n+3)E[r^(2n)]/34, E[r^(2n)]<(2n+1)!!/34^n, and E[exp(lambda r^2)]<=(1-lambda/17)^(-3/2) for 0<=lambda<17.

The earlier conservative bridge estimates prove H_y''(q)>0 for every q>=1/4 and every 0<|y|<1/2. This remains a valid subtheorem and is strengthened by SOH-G024-P and then globally completed by SOH-G024-R.

For each theta channel, -g_n''=4r+24r/(2r-3)^2>19 for r>3. Combined with the canonical G004 mixture slope variance bound Var_p(g_n')<2, this proves L''=-(log K)''>17 globally. Consequently -C'/C>34u, N_y(u)>33u, -H_y'/H_y>33/2, and the bridge moment/MGF hierarchy sharpens from denominators 20/10 to 34/17.

Using L''>17, the existing upper envelope L''(s)<21 exp(2|s|), the sharpened bridge MGF, and exact rational bounds C_17<79 and F(u)=33+1089u^2-79exp(2u)>0 on 1/3<=u<=1/2, the exact bridge normal form proves H_y''(q)>0 for every q>=1/9 and every 0<|y|<1/2. This is a strict analytic subtheorem of the global SOH-G024-R result.

For L=-log K of the even full-line Riemann kernel, L''''(t)<20 L''(t) for every real t. On 0<=t<=2/5 this is certified by outward interval arithmetic with explicit theta terms n=1..4 and analytically bounded n>=5 tails; for t>=2/5 it is proved analytically by dominant-channel plus perturbation bounds. Evenness extends the claim to all real t. The interval engine is mpmath.iv and is part of the explicit trust boundary.

Using SOH-G024-Q in the exact bridge trapezoid identity, the compact core satisfies S_y'(q)<12275/48 while SOH-G024-M gives S_y(q)^2>1089/4, leaving the strict Riccati gap 793/48. Together with SOH-G024-P this proves H_y''(q)>0 for every q>=0 and every 0<|y|<1/2. The compact-core part depends on the computer-assisted interval certificate Q; derivative orders m>=3 remain open.

Finite five-point diagnostics through derivative order four are FINITE_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_PROOF wherever no theorem applies. First and second complete-monotonicity inequalities are globally proved on G024, with the second-order compact-core closure carrying the explicit computer-assisted dependency SOH-G024-Q. Orders m>=3 remain open.
